and the amount due upto March, 2015 for
subsidy of rice distribution from Central
Government under various schemes is yet
to be received by the State Government

released at the earliest?

Maharashtra

the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has any plan
to introduce paperless railway tickets and
railway platform tickets at all stations of
Maharashtra or at some selected railway
stations;
(b) whether this is going to be selective;
and

the reason for selected stations instead of

thereof?

Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,

mechanism to control its prices?

Haridaspur-Paradip broad-gauge rail link
project along with the time-line fixed for
its completion; and

for its timely completion ?

start Horticulture Misson in Andhra

SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:

been allowed under the said scheme and
public sector insurance companies, which

Minister of AGRICULTURE AND

assessing individuals or agencies is
undertaken by the Central or State
Government in Punjab and other States;

whether the Ministry received periodic

Minister of AGRICULTURE AND

amount of compensation paid by
Government of Punjab for cotton crop loss
due to whitefly attack, if so, the details
thereof;

to state:
